events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw for 344 yards and four touchdowns, helping the Atlanta Falcons tighten their grip on first place in the NFC South with a 43-28 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Thursday ni
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan throws for  4 TDs to lead Falcons over Bucs 43-28

headlines.description: Rookie quarterback Dak Prescott threw three touchdown passes and kept any talk for Tony Romo unnecessary, leading the Dallas Cowboys to a 35-10 win on Sunday over the winless Cleveland Browns.

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: The Kansas City Chiefs stuffed the offensively inept Jacksonville Jaguars on fourth down with less than 2 minutes left deep in their own territory on Sunday, preserving a 19-14 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs shut down Bortles, Jaguars to escape with 19-14 win

events.name: New York Jets at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Rookie Kenyan Drake scored untouched on a 96-yard kickoff return with 5:15 left Sunday, and the Miami Dolphins won a seesaw battle with the New York Jets, 27-23.
headlines.shortLinkText: Drake's 96-yard kickoff return helps Miami beat Jets 27-23

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw a 28-yard touchdown pass to Golden Tate, who vaulted into the end zone in overtime to give the Detroit Lions a 22-16 victory over the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tate's TD in OT lifts Lions over Vikings, 22-16

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New York Giants

headlines.description: Eli Manning threw for four touchdowns and New York's defense had two interceptions and three stops on fourth downs to beat Philadelphia 28-23 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants hold on, Manning has 4 TD passes in 28-23 win

headlines.description: Joe Flacco threw a 95-yard touchdown pass to Mike Wallace, and the Baltimore Ravens frustrated an ineffective Ben Roethlisberger in a 21-14 victory over the Pittsburgh Steelers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens frustrate Roethlisberger in 21-14 win over Steelers

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Cam Newton persevered through five sacks to pass for 225 yards and a touchdown, and the Carolina Panthers' defense shut down Los Angeles in a 13-10 victory over the slumping Rams on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton sacked 5 times, still leads Panthers past Rams 13-10

events.name: New Orleans Saints at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Drew Brees threw a pair of touchdown passes to Michael Thomas and another to Mark Ingram, who also ran for a 75-yard TD a week after being benched as the New Orleans Saints beat the lowly 49ers
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees leads Saints to fourth win in five after 0-3 start

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Frank Gore rushed for two touchdowns, Jordan Todman had a tone-setting 99-yard return on the opening kickoff, and the Indianapolis Colts held on late for a 31-26 win on Sunday over Green Bay.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gore, Todman power Colts, before D holds off Packers 31-26

events.name: Tennessee Titans at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Melvin Gordon ran for a career-high 196 yards and scored the go-ahead TD on a 1-yard run, and DBs Dwight Lowery and Brandon Flowers scored on turnovers by Marcus Mariota to lead the Chargers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gordon, defense lead Chargers over Mariota, Titans, 43-35

headlines.description: Latavius Murray ran for 114 yards and three touchdowns and the Oakland Raiders showed they were ready for prime time, beating the defending Super Bowl champion Denver Broncos 30-20 Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders run past Broncos 30-20 for AFC West lead

headlines.description: Jimmy Graham needed only one hand to catch two first-half TD passes from Russell Wilson, and the Seattle Seahawks held off a late rally for a 31-25 win over the Buffalo Bills on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Graham catches 2 TDs, Seahawks hold off Bills 31-25
